title: Collision Course
project: A two-minute orchestral space cue in object-based spatial audio: a fast object closes, collides, and the survivors escape
brief: make that adm object based spatial 120 sec 8 channel with added emotions, suspense, tension, high speed space object collision escaping; music should visualise the story; flac 8 channel output
audience: a listener in an immersive room who should see a story with their ears: a quiet void, an object that comes from far behind and hits, and a ship that flees
purpose: a 120 second cue in which every spatial move is a story beat: the object approaches, the impact lands in the middle of the room, debris scatters and the survivors escape
point_of_view: the listener sits at the centre of the field and is hunted, hit and set free
job: hold suspense with almost nothing for sixteen seconds
make the approach audible as a source that moves from far behind to the front and speeds up
land the collision on the first beat of bar 31 and cut to silence
scatter the debris outward, then escape with a faster pulse and a climb
end in relief on E with one high piano note
story: a pedal and a clock; a far object appears; it comes closer and faster; impact; silence and flying fragments; a fast escape and a heroic climb; relief

sections.name: Silence
sections.action: suspense: nothing moves but a clock and a low pedal; a piano asks the question and no one answers
sections.music: the organ pedal holds E, the celesta ticks every beat, the piano plays the theme once softly, a string bed rises under the last four bars

sections.name: Contact
sections.action: detection: something is out there; the clock speeds up and a far object appears
sections.music: a horn states the theme, the clock goes to eighth notes, a piano arpeggio, a cello pulse and a low brass swell begin, the first far violin runs

sections.name: Approach
sections.action: the object closes at high speed: tension climbs bar by bar
sections.music: strings and horn carry the theme, organ chords and choir arrive, the violin runs get faster and nearer, timpani rolls, one climbing line to the top

sections.name: Collision
sections.action: impact: everything lands on the downbeat of bar 31, then a hard cut into silence
sections.music: timpani, taiko, organ, choir and low brass on one huge E minor chord; at bar 32 beat 3 everything stops

sections.name: Debris
sections.action: the aftermath: cold, empty, fragments flying outward; the clock has stopped
sections.music: the pedal alone and a quiet low bed; celesta and harp glints scatter to the left and right and up; the piano remembers two notes of the theme

sections.name: Escape
sections.action: survival: the clock restarts, a fast pulse, a heroic theme, a second climb to the top
sections.music: a sixteenth-note piano arpeggio and harp orbit, cello eighths, timpani and taiko, strings and horn sing the theme, violin runs flee and recede, the climbing line again

sections.name: Drift
sections.action: relief: silence returns, the pedal, one held horn E and a last piano note
sections.music: the pedal and a soft bed, a slow clock, the piano fragment, the choir and the horn hold E, one high piano B

motifs.name: the warning
motifs.shape: eight slow notes: up a fifth, down to the third, then up a sixth, a step and a fall; every note is a chord tone
motifs.returns: 16 s: horn. 32 s: strings and horn. 40 s: strings an octave up. 52 s: the climbing line. 80 s: two notes. 88 s: heroic horn and strings. 100 s: the climbing line again. 108 s: two notes and a held E

hits.sound: the full ensemble and the first rush of the object
hits.why: the approach must feel like a new level

hits.sound: timpani, taiko and the whole ensemble on one chord, the object arriving at the centre of the room
hits.why: the collision is the centre of the story

hits.sound: a cut into silence, then glints flying outward
hits.why: a cut is stronger than a decay, and the debris needs a clean start

must_hear: the pedal and the clock from the first second
the hit at the middle of the room

references: a sustained pipe-organ pedal under a ticking clock, a pulse that speeds up, a fast solo line that tears across the room and a hard cut into silence
fragments of sound thrown outward from the centre after an impact, and a heroic line that climbs while a pulse races

expression.sonic_picture: In the first ten seconds a very low organ pedal sits under a dry celesta tick; a soft piano asks a slow question; later a far violin streak appears behind the listener; at the middle every instrument lands on one chord in the centre and stops; fragments scatter outward; a fast pulse and a heroic line escape; the last note is a held horn E and one high piano note.
expression.performer: The organist holds the pedal. The pianist plays softly and lets each note ring, then keeps the arpeggio even. The violin section plays the runs as fast as a section can, accelerating. The cellists dig in on every beat. The timpanist rolls into each turn. The percussionist keeps the clock light and stops it at the impact.
expression.producer_moves: Each section adds one lever: the clock, the cello pulse, the object, the full ensemble. The object is a moving source; the room tightens before the hit and opens after it. The cut at the impact is the effect. The pedal is low-passed so it is a floor and not a second voice. Every part shares one space.
expression.anti_generic: The generic version is a swelling pad and a drum loop; this one tells a story with positions: a thing comes from behind, hits in the centre, flies apart and leaves.

cues.mode_register: E minor, low pedal and one piano

cues.articulation: legato horn over an even arpeggio

cues.mode_register: E minor, middle to high register
cues.articulation: a driving pulse, fast runs, a climbing line

cues.mode_register: E minor with hope, high register
cues.articulation: a fast pulse and a heroic theme

theme.contour: up a fifth, down to the third, up a sixth, a step on, a fall
theme.interval_character: leaps of a third and a fifth between chord tones, no passing notes: slow and open
theme.rhythm_cell: eight half-note pulses, one per bar half, so the theme breathes at the speed of a slow clock
theme.why_memorable: every note is a chord tone held for a beat pair: it can be hummed after one hearing and it grows each time it is doubled
theme.variation_plan: piano alone; horn an octave down; strings and horn; strings an octave up; a climbing line; two notes; a heroic horn and strings; the climb again; two notes and a held E

immersive.why: the cue is a story told by where things are: the object arrives from far behind and hits at the centre, the debris flies outward, the ship leaves behind; a stereo mix can say it, a field can place it

movers.why: it is the object: it approaches, collides and then leaves as the escaping ship
movers.path: from far behind on the left at 10 m, closing to the front at 1.2 m by the collision, then from the centre to behind on the right at 10 m over the escape

movers.why: fragments thrown out of the impact
movers.path: from the centre outward to 110 degrees on the left and 25 degrees up over eight bars

movers.why: fragments thrown out of the impact on the other side
movers.path: from the centre outward to 120 degrees on the right and 35 degrees up over eight bars

movers.why: during the escape it circles the listener as the sparkle of speed
movers.path: an orbit of the listener at 28 degrees up, one and a half turns over the escape

room_changes.why: the room tightens as the object closes: a nearer, drier space
after the impact the space is vast, cold and empty

must_hear: the impact in the middle of the room
immersive.notes: the sheet records intent; the mix, space and instrument presets execute it. Trajectories, heights and room geometry are in presets. ADM/BW64 carries the moving parts as objects; the 7.1 file is a fixed 8-channel render.

gate_reason: a film cue with a theme, a peak, a hard cut and a relief ending: the cinematic profile, nothing relaxed
notes: The cue is original. The objects are instruments: no sound effects were asked for or used. The sound is the General MIDI SoundFont with velocity_timbre on every bowed, blown and struck part. Delivered as stereo, 8-channel 7.1 and ADM/BW64 objects.
